stage2_output.decision_rationale: The paper is written in English and presents an original research contribution extending the DCR Process Highlighter with an NLP module to support declarative process generation from natural language descriptions (i.e., extracting/aligning roles, activities, constraints). It explicates concrete method components (NLP module using WordNet and a user-interaction-trained dataset for suggestions) and reports empirical evaluations/experiments (collected experiences with the tool and exploratory results).
